ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND ( RecordType.Name = "Component Services", TEXT(StageName) <> "Closed Lost", ISCHANGED(StageName) && ( CASE( StageName, "Capture",1, "Evaluation",2, "Activation",3, "Execution",4, "Release",5, "Closed Won",6, 0) - CASE(PRIORVALUE(StageName), "Capture",1, "Evaluation",2, "Activation",3, "Execution",4, "Release",5, "Closed Won",6, 0) <> 1) )
